description: This file defines the NetworkStatusService class responsible for asynchronously determining the current network status on an iOS device. It uses Network framework's NWPathMonitor to monitor network changes and employs async/await patterns to provide a payload indicating network connectivity, interfaces, and constraints. It also includes an internal helper class NetworkStatusState for thread-safe state tracking.

classes.name: NetworkStatusService
classes.description: A service providing asynchronous network status reports, utilizing NWPathMonitor and async/await.

classes.name: NetworkStatusState
classes.description: A thread-safe helper class to track completion state of network status requests.

methods.name: currentStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current network status with a specified timeout.

methods.name: payload(from:)
methods.description: Builds a network status payload from a given NWPath object.

methods.name: fallbackPayload
methods.description: Provides a default payload indicating no network connectivity.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks the internal state as completed in a thread-safe manner and returns whether it was previously incomplete.
